newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says it has details of Pyongyang apology.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says it has details of Pyongyang apology.

text.p: South Korea has details of a Pyongyang apology over the intrusion of a North Korean submarine in September, a foreign ministry official said on Saturday.
"We are aware of the details," the official in the spokesman's office said by telephone. "But I cannot confirm whether the government has received an official apology yet."
Sunday morning editions of several South Korean newspapers seen on Saturday evening reported that Seoul has been handed an apology by Pyongyang.
"What you see in the newspapers comes pretty close," the official said. "By tomorrow this whole affair should be wrapped up."
The submarine landed 26 heavily armed North Koreans on an east coast beach. Twenty-four were shot and killed, one was captured alive and one is still on the loose.

South Korea has demanded an apology as the price of resuming aid to the North and implementing a 1994 agreement between Washington and Pyongyang under which it will supply nuclear reactors to North Korea.
